_comment: Lines for the guard at the archery range (Guards/ArcheryGuard in the outskirts scene). Same categories as guard_flavor_text.json.
hail: Mind the line, traveler. Nobody crosses in front of the shooters.
Care to loose a few? The targets don't mind, and they can't complain about your aim.
Stay behind the marker while the range is hot. I'd hate to explain an arrow in the leg.
Practice makes the difference between a hunter and a dinner. Shoot straight.
Fletcher's shafts fly truer than the ones from the market. Take that from someone who's seen both.
Those targets take a beating. Straw's cheap, at least. Faces are harder to replace.
Sand gets in everything out here. Wax your strings and check them twice.
engage: Something's loose near the range! Hold there!
Not on my range, you vermin!
banter: Too many people can't judge distance out here. Everything's farther than it looks.
Dead still on a calm day, and someone still finds a way to miss.
If I had a copper for every arrow in the dirt behind those targets, I'd have retired.
Wind's picking up. Someone's going to blame the wind.
Heard a peddler's been working the west road. Might be worth saving a few coins.
